messages:
leslie_cs: heads-up — BoxData just opened an escalation. They say invoice parsing outputs changed after yesterday's rollout, some fields missing/merged. request_id: req_0a1b2c3d. they gave a failing prompt + output.
boxdata-support-bot: [BoxData] Hi, we were on model redwood-llm-v3.2.1 (hosted). Prompt: \u2018Parse invoice: \u201cInvoice\u00A0#\u00A01234\u201d date: 01/02/2026 ...\u2019 Output now drops the invoice number or sticks it to the next field. This worked before. Urgent for them.
leslie_cs: thx. @maria_cs can you pick this up? ask for full curl, sdk version, region, and the exact model param they used. also ask for sample attachments if any.
maria_cs: pinged them for the raw curl + sdk logs. they already sent a curl snippet: 
``` 
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_X" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-v3.2.1","input":"Parse invoice:\\nInvoice\u00A0#\u00A01234\\nDate: 01/02/2026\\nTotal: $1,200"}'
```
+maria_cs: they attached trace id: trace-20260310-07-9f3a. using SDK 1.8.0. region us-east-1.
deploy-bot: deploy v3.2.1 rolled to 10% canary at 2026-03-10T03:12:00Z (release: tokenizer-normalizer-change).
sara_ml: assigning. quick note: v3.2.1 included a tokenizer-normalizer change that toggles unicode invisibles stripping for perf. internal evals (invoice-eval-suite) ran against sanitized testcases that don't contain NBSPs or ZWNBSP; so they passed.
leslie_cs: summary: customer prompt contains non-breaking space (NBSP, U+00A0) between 'Invoice' and '#', which may be normalized differently now. they say behavior changed.
nate_eng: can you paste the exact model output they saw?
boxdata-support-bot: customer output: \u201cInvoice#\u00A01234Date:01/02/2026\u201d (invoice number concatenated with label, fields merged). before it was parsed as separate lines/fields.
sara_ml: ok that matches a tokenization boundary shift. two possibilities: normalizer removed NBSP earlier but still left a delimiter token; now NBSP is stripped and joins tokens. also sampling deterministic thresholds slightly differ after small quantization tweak included in same release. but token join looks primary.
maria_cs: customer asks for a quick mitigation — they can't afford wrong invoice numbers in prod. any quick toggle we can offer?
sara_ml: short-term: route their requests to redwood-llm-v3.1.4 (previous model) by setting model param; that avoids the tokenizer change. I'll prepare a canary revert for the tokenizer-normalizer flag.
leslie_cs: please draft a small repro we can run locally. include their exact bytes (NBSP encoded). we need to reproduce deterministically.
sara_ml: repro snippet (will run in notebook):
```python
from redwood_sdk import Redwood
r = Redwood(api_key="sk_X", region="us-east-1")
prompt = "Parse invoice:\nInvoice\u00A0#\u00A01234\nDate: 01/02/2026\nTotal: $1,200"
for model in ["redwood-llm-v3.1.4","redwood-llm-v3.2.1"]:
    out = r.generate(model=model, input=prompt, max_tokens=80)
    print(model, "->", out.text)
```
sara_ml: initial local run: v3.1.4 preserves spacing and outputs separate fields; v3.2.1 merges invoice label+number into single token. repro confirmed.
olive_pm: note for tracking: BoxData is on a paid dedicated plan but using hosted endpoint; impact high. need a postmortem item to add NBSP/edgecases to invoice-eval-suite.
nate_eng: digging into runtime logs for trace-20260310-07-9f3a. Looks like the request hit canary allocation (10% traffic) and was served by node gpu-2a. attaching small log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-10T03:15:21Z] trace-20260310-07-9f3a request model=redwood-llm-v3.2.1 tokenizer=normalizer-v2 kernel=mmq-8bit node=gpu-2a
[...]
log: tokenized_input=["Parse","invoice","#","1234"]  <-- but NBSP got stripped leading to collapse
```
nate_eng: kernel/mmq-8bit quantization patch also rolled in the same release; will verify if that changed sampling but unlikely to cause field merge.
sara_ml: root cause: tokenizer normalizer change removed NBSP which changed token boundaries; internal evals missed NBSP cases. remediation plan: 1) immediate: recommend customer switch to model=redwood-llm-v3.1.4 (or set header X-Redwood-Tokenizer: legacy) — we can support temporary header toggle for affected orgs. 2) short term: revert tokenizer-normalizer flag in canary and push hotfix to restore NBSP-preserving path. 3) long term: extend invoice-eval-suite to include NBSP, ZWNBSP, soft-hyphen, and other unicode edgecases; add regression test.
maria_cs: told BoxData the workaround (model=redwood-llm-v3.1.4) + asked if they'd like us to flip header for them while we hotfix. awaiting confirmation.
leslie_cs: great. @sara_ml can you open a changelog PR and include the testcases? also create a rollback runbook for the tokenizer flag (nate to own the rollout).
sara_ml: opening PR now: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/PR-3124 comment has failing sample and test additions.
nate_eng: I'll prepare rollback. planning a canary revert and smoke tests. ETA 2 hours.
boxdata-support-bot: Customer replied: yes please route us to legacy model for now. they appreciate the quick turnaround.
olivia_pm: capturing action items for postmortem: add to timeline, customer impact, and commit to expanding evals. also make sure billing/SLAs are considered for routing.
leslie_cs: thanks team. I'll keep thread updated. once hotfix deployed we'll follow up with customer and close. :thumbsup:
